question: Where is the hackathon held, and where must projects be published?
answer_text: The hackathon is hosted at NIT Hamirpur. Projects must be pushed to a public GitHub repository under an open-source license.

passages.text: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Hamirpur x GDG Ludhiana is a one-day in-person mini hackathon hosted at NIT Hamirpur. Teams arrive in the morning, form a team, build a small project from scratch and demo it the same afternoon. All development work must start at the event. Projects or codebases begun before the day are not eligible.
